name: Hallow
description:
Casting time: 1 day, or 1 hour if you are within your Sanctum.

You perform a ritual that marks an area with a radius of up to medium range as a place of power. The ritual must incorporate some meaningful feature of the place—a boundary, monument, grave, hearth, altar, tree, or other permanent feature—which becomes the focus of the magic. Choose one of the following manifestations:

  • Valor: Creatures you designate within the area cannot be compelled to flee and cannot be forced to check Conditions while they remain there.

  • Veil: You fill the area with magical darkness or illumination. You determine its appearance and intensity.

  • Rest: Dead creatures laid to rest within the area are protected from disturbance. Their remains cannot be unearthed, damaged, or returned to life by magic.

  • Dread: When creatures you designate enter the area, and again after each minute they remain there, they check a Condition.

  • Truce: All attack rolls made within the area are ill-favored, and damage dealt there is halved.

  • Concord: Creatures within the area can understand one another regardless of the languages they speak.

  • Closed Ways: The boundaries of the area cannot be crossed by magical movement or by creatures or objects that are phased out.

  • Hidden Place: The area is concealed from magical observation. Magical sensors cannot perceive anything within it, and creatures inside cannot be targeted by magic that reads their thoughts or senses.

The manifestation remains until the magic is dispelled. A creature can overcome the manifestation only if its Challenge is greater than the spell's XP cost. A spell can overcome or dispel the manifestation only if its XP cost is greater than this spell's.

Describe the ritual you perform, the feature you make its focus, and how the place changes when the magic takes hold.
